It's time to check in!
Choose how to get your boarding pass below.
Arrive 2 hours prior to departure.
The U.S. Transportation Security Administration (TSA) has advised passengers to expect longer than normal wait times at security checkpoints. The recommended arrival time for domestic travel is 2 hours before your scheduled departure time.

Restrictions on Smart Bags / Luggage
Due to a potential safety hazard, "Smart" bags (luggage with charging devices or powered by a lithium-ion battery) cannot fly unless the battery can be removed. Effective January 15, 2018. Please see our Restricted Articles page for more information.

FREE! Paperless Mobile Boarding Pass

Check-in, add bags, purchase seats & view your boarding pass on the FREE Allegiant mobile app.

Download App

FREE! Print your boarding pass at home!

Check in online and print your paper boarding pass from 24 hours and up to 45 minutes before your scheduled flight departure.

Check in online

$5 per printed boarding pass

Customers who require the assistance of a ticket agent to print boarding pass(es) at the airport will pay a $5 charge (no cash please) per boarding pass printed. This charge does not apply to passengers who are ineligible for advance check-in.

We are a CASH FREE airline, but we do accept most major credit and debit cards.
Airport ticket counters and check-in close 45 minutes prior to scheduled flight departure. Please plan to:
  • Arrive at the airport at least two (2) hours prior to scheduled flight departure.
  • Be checked in, through airport security and at the boarding gate at least one (1) hour before departure.
  • Be on board the aircraft at least 20 minutes prior to departure.
  • Aircraft door closes 15 minutes prior to departure and will not re-open.
As a reminder, Allegiant does not accept cash at our airports. All payments for any baggage, boarding pass or flight change accommodations transactions must be paid by credit or debit card.

Here are some tips to make
your trip more enjoyable

Flight Status Alerts

Sign up for Flight Status Alerts here to get a text message if your flight is changed or cancelled.

Arrive 2 hours prior to departure.

Plan to be at the airport 2 hours in advance. Checked baggage must be dropped off at the ticket counter at least 45 minutes prior to scheduled departure. All passengers must be seated on the plane 20 minutes before departure.

Choose Your Seats

The choice is yours! If you prefer to select where you sit on the plane, please purchase seats in advance. Otherwise, your seat will be randomly assigned when you check in. Click here to add seats to your itinerary.

Weigh and measure your luggage

Make sure each checked bag weighs less than 40lbs, and that your carry-on items meet size requirements. Otherwise excess baggage fees apply. Find important baggage size information here.

No-Show Policy
Failure to board a flight or to change or cancel an itinerary within the specified cancellation policies set forth in the Terms and Conditions shall be deemed a customer-initiated cancellation and the remaining itinerary, including any return flights, will be canceled and all funds will be forfeited.
